report.body: added the enamel mug first and THEN the coffee beans. In the cart the coffee beans row is on top. I clicked Remove on the coffee beans row and it was the mug that disappeared, the beans stayed. Chrome, mac.

# Remove button deletes the wrong item

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:4100/.
Stay on localhost:4100 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do these in order:
1. Open the enamel mug product
2. Click Add to cart for the enamel mug
3. Open the coffee beans product
4. Click Add to cart for the coffee beans
5. Open the cart
6. Click Remove on the coffee beans row
The reporter says the correct behavior is that after clicking Remove on the coffee beans row, the cart no longer shows the coffee beans and still shows the enamel mug. Verify that after clicking Remove on the coffee beans row, the cart no longer shows the coffee beans and still shows the enamel mug.

verdict.headline: Kane followed the reported steps and the expected behavior held on this version.
